newsitem.title: USA: Angeion says FDA clears Sentinel studies.
newsitem.headline: Angeion says FDA clears Sentinel studies.

text.p: Angeion Corp said it received an investigational device exemption from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for clinical studies of the company's Sentinel 2010 implantable defibrillator.

In October, the company said it started U.S. clinical studies with the device, which regulates too-rapid heartbeat. The first implant was done in a 65-year-old woman with coronary artery disease. "The patient is doing well," Angeion said.
The 2010 model is the first of Angeion's ICDs to provide stored electrograms as well as enhanced programming features for the electrophysiologist, the company said.
